header.name: Introduction to Deep Learning
header.description: Deep learning has become a foundational paradigm for solving complex problems in artificial intelligence, powering advances in computer vision, natural language processing, speech, and scientific computing. This course provides an in-depth study of the theoretical principles and modern architectures of deep learning, including techniques for model optimization, representation learning, and sequence and graph-based learning. Through a combination of rigorous analysis and hands-on implementation, students will develop the ability to design, evaluate, and adapt deep learning models for research and real-world applications while critically assessing their performance and limitations.
prerequisites_mandatory: Introduction to Machine Learning or Machine Learning
prerequisites_mandatory_resolved: Introduction to Machine Learning or Machine Learning

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Explain the fundamental concepts of deep learning and describe the working principles of common neural network architectures such as Multilayer Perceptrons (MLPs), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Autoencoders, and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs).

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Analyze the performance, strengths, and limitations of different deep learning models for a given problem and interpret their experimental results.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Apply appropriate deep learning models and frameworks to implement solutions for basic tasks in domains such as image classification, text processing, and representation learning.

lecture_topics: McCullogh-Pitts, Hebbian Law, Adaline, Madaline, Perceptron
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Separating Hyperplanes, Loss and Risk, Over/Under fitting
Recap of Multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) & Back-propagation algorithm
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Implementation: Backprop, Data Loaders, Training Pipeline

lecture_topics: Pooling, Receptive field, Padding, Stride, and Dilation
Activation functions, Normalization, Regularization, Hyper-parameter Optimization
Generative Modelling: Autoencoders (AEs), Variational AEs and Generative Adversiarial Networks (GANs)
Long Short Term Memory models (LSTMs) and Gated Recurrent Units (GRU)
Introduction to Transformers: Embeddings, Self/multi-head Attention, Positional Encoding, Encoder-Decoder models
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Implement a sacable attention variant such as flash, multi-query, sparse, sliding-window or heirarchical attention.

lecture_topics: Introduction to Graph Neural Networks and Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN)
Ethics, Safety, Bias & Robustness in DL Models
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Implement a GCN with PyTorch Geometric

lecture_topics: Overview of Model Compression: Pruning, Quantization, Knowledge Distillation and Transfer Learning
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Implement a model compression techniques for a DNN
